content.comment_body: I'm able to log in and register, but it brings me back to the same screen and doesn't let me download. Please see the attached image—how do I proceed? Registering doesn't allow me to continue the download.

1.) You need to complete an additional registration step. 2.) Even after providing all required details, you won't be able to download instantly. [company_name] will review your information first. If your registration is approved, you'll get an email with confirmation and download access. Downloading is not possible before this approval.

This topic is closed because the question was posted twice. The second thread titled 'Can not download software' is available in the [product_name] - Software section. Best regards, [user_name]_Moderator

analysis.insight_summary: The user finds the download process for [company_name] software confusing. While registration and login seem successful, they don't lead directly to download access, causing frustration. The actual process involves an additional manual verification and email approval, which is not clearly indicated within the user interface. Users expect straightforward registration and immediate download availability but instead encounter unexpected delays and unclear instructions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that after registering and logging in, the software download should be instantly accessible, guided by a simple and clear step-by-step process.
